title: Smell and taste effects

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Smell and taste effects are defined as any subjective effect which directly alters either a person's sense of smell or their sense of taste. 

This page lists and describes the various auditory effects which can occur under the influence of certain psychoactive compounds.

Gustatory hallucinations

Gustatory intensification

Gustatory suppression

Olfactory hallucinations

Olfactory intensification

Olfactory suppression

See also

*Subjective effect index
*Visual effects

References
